Language

ELIZA and conversational patterns

Scripted pattern matching produced a convincing surface of conversation.

Joseph Weizenbaum

The contribution

ELIZA analyzed input using rules and transformation patterns to generate replies. The paper showed how a limited conversational program could sustain an interaction without requiring a broad representation of the world.

What this does not establish

Fluent-looking replies did not establish that ELIZA understood the conversation. Its behavior depended on scripts and pattern transformations.

Why this date?

The linked article appeared in January 1966.
